title: Singular normal-cone billiard paths in the regular tetrahedron

tetrahedron.face_convention: A, B, C, D denote the faces opposite the corresponding vertices.

notation.AB: edge hit on F_A cap F_B
notation.ABC: vertex hit on F_A cap F_B cap F_C

summary.equivalence: cyclic, reversal, and full tetrahedral relabeling
summary.method: Enumerate primitive cyclic active-face stratum words with disjoint adjacent active sets; minimize polygonal length over the product of closed strata; retain relative-interior minimizers satisfying the normal-cone velocity-jump condition.
